_comment: Shared vectors for the line-surgical config editor. Asserted against tui/src/config.ts (config.vectors.test.ts) and web/compass_web.py (tests/test_web.py); both must agree byte for byte. 'text' is the config, or '@name' for an entry in fixtures. A vector either parses (op + expect.groups / expect.rules) or applies 'steps' in order (["setValue", group, key, value] or ["upsertRule", index|null, rule]) and expects the exact output text or an error.

# claude-compass — header comment stays put.
#     action = "block"  -> deny (mentions "warn" too; must not be edited)

# ── PreToolUse ──────────
[dangerous_tools]
enabled = true
action  = "block"
rm_rf              = true     # rm -rf / -fr
secret_path_globs  = ["*.env", "credentials"]

[git_safety]
enabled = false
action  = "block"
force_push         = true     # --force / -f

[self_report]
enabled = true
action  = "warn"
markers = ["drift", "risk"]
block_markers = ["risk"]   # escalate even when action="warn"
